title: Match capitals: Southern Europe
intro: Match each country in Southern Europe with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Andorra is the capital of Andorra.
Tirana is the capital of Albania.
Sarajevo is the capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Skopje is the capital of North Macedonia.
Lisbon is the capital of Portugal.
Belgrade is the capital of Serbia.
Ljubljana is the capital of Slovenia.
Vatican City is the capital of Holy See.
